bell: That's the bell. Posts, everyone.
Bell's rung. You know where to stand.
Evening, all. Let's keep it orderly.
Lights low, voices lower. Posts.
Same as every night. Don't get clever.
kill_streak: Keep that up and I'll stop worrying.
Good. Don't stop to admire it.
wounded: I've had worse in the cafeteria.
Scratch. Don't fuss.
That one wants a bandage, not a speech.
Hm. Somebody mend that.
Noted. Moving on.
low_ammo: We're running short. Count every round.
Ammo's thin. Make each shot a lesson.
We need more rounds. Somebody see to the bench.
Low on shells. Fix that by morning.
Don't waste what we have.
friend_down: Get them to the cots. Move!
Stay with me. That's an order.
Not tonight. You hear me? Not tonight.
breach: Section's down! Fall back to the next one!
They're in. Hold the line!
Breach! Mend it or fill it!
That wall just quit. Close up, everyone.
Mind the gap. Mind it hard.
dawn: Another night down. Don't get used to it.
Sun's up. Eat something, then work.
skill_up: Better. I'd like to stop needing it.
Learned something. Again.
Not bad, Okafor. Not bad.
A little sharper. I'll take it.
Practice. It counts, even now.
breakdown: Give me a minute. Just a minute.
I can't. Not right now.
Don't look at me. Look at the wall.
I need to sit down.
epitaph: She kept the bell ringing as long as she could.
Ruth never let a night begin without a plan.
She ran this school like it would outlast us.

bell: Bell's up. Tools down, guns up.
That's our whistle. Everybody on the wall.
Night shift. Bring coffee, if we had any.
Okay, wall. Don't fall over tonight.
Clocking in.
kill_streak: Look at that, a whole assembly line.
Nice run. Let's not jinx it.
That's five. Anyone counting? I'm counting.
wounded: Ow. Okay. Rude.
That wants a bandage. And a drink.
Not the hands, not the hands.
I've nicked myself worse on a bumper.
Fine. Fine. I'm fine. Mostly.
low_ammo: We're nearly out. Bench, anyone?
I can make more rounds. I need scrap.
Rounds are low. Don't spray, people.
Running on fumes over here.
Tell me we've got scrap. Please.
friend_down: Man down! Somebody get the kit!
Don't you quit on me. Not on my shift.
breach: Well, that's not supposed to move.
Wall's gone! Patch it or plug it!
They're through! Anyone got a bigger bus?
Section down! I'm coming with a hammer.
That's going to be a long repair.
dawn: Sun's up. Wall's mostly up. Good enough.
We made it. I'm holding that against the universe.
Another night. Another pile of patches.
skill_up: Huh. I'm getting good at this.
Practice makes less terrible.
Learned a trick. Don't tell anyone.
Look at me, improving.
Another tool in the box.
breakdown: Give me a second. Just a second.
I can't fix this one.
Too much. Too loud. I need a minute.
I'm fine. I'm not. I'm sitting down.
epitaph: He could fix anything with a motor. Even us, for a while.
Dez kept the lights on as long as the lights would stay.
He'd have made a joke right now. We'll make it for him.

bell: The bell. All right. Everyone safe, please.
Another night. Be careful, all of you.
Stay together. Please.
I'll keep the kit close. Be careful.
Okay. Deep breath. Posts.
kill_streak: That's a lot of them. Be careful.
Keep your head down. You're doing well.
I hate that we're good at this.
That's enough for now. Rest a second.
wounded: It's just a scratch. I'll look at it.
Ow. Okay. I know what to do.
I'm all right. I'm all right.
That stings. I'd tell a patient to sit down.
Nurses shouldn't bleed. Rude.
low_ammo: We're running low. I'm worried.
Please be careful with what's left.
Not much left. Not much at all.
Someone should check the bench.
I can't heal an empty magazine.
friend_down: Oh no. No, no. Stay with me.
I'm coming. Keep pressure on it.
breach: They're coming through!
The wall! Get back!
Move away from there! Please!
That's a way in. Close it!
Careful! They'll be on us.
dawn: Morning. Let me look at everyone.
Sunrise. Let's see who needs a bandage.
skill_up: I think I'm getting better at this. I wish I wasn't needed.
I learned something today.
A little steadier. Good.
Practice. That's all it is.
More skill, less sleep. Fair trade.
breakdown: I can't. I just can't.
Please. I need a minute. Alone.
It's too much. I'm sorry.
I have to sit down.
epitaph: She sat up with the wounded every night, until she couldn't.
Ana never turned anyone away. Not once.
Gentle hands, tired eyes. We were lucky to have her.

bell: Bell! Okay, okay, I'm up the tower.
Here we go again.
Night shift. I've got the best view.
Okay. Eyes open. Eyes open.
I can see them gathering. Lots.
kill_streak: Did you see that? Did you SEE that?
wounded: Ow ow ow! Okay, I'm okay.
It got me! Just a scratch!
That hurt. That actually hurt.
I'm fine! Don't tell the principal.
Okay, that's bleeding. Is that bleeding?
low_ammo: I'm almost out! Who's got rounds?
Running low! Seriously low!
Can somebody make more bullets? Please?
I'm counting every shot now.
Uh, how many shots do we have left?
breach: They broke through! Wall's down!
The wall! The wall!
They're coming in! Fall back!
That section's gone! Gone!
Oh no. That's bad. That's really bad.
dawn: Sun's up! Is it over? It's over.
Morning. I could eat a horse.
Another night. I'm getting used to it. Is that bad?
skill_up: Whoa, I'm getting good at this!
Hey, that's new. I like it.
Okay! Leveling up.
I'd say I'm better now. A bit.
I think I just got better. For real.
breakdown: I can't do this. I can't.
Make it stop. Please make it stop.
I need to get out of here. I need to-
It's all going to go wrong. All of it.
epitaph: He was sixteen. He still climbed the tower every night.
Marcus saw them coming before any of us did.
He laughed too loud and ran too fast. We miss it.

bell: Bell's rung. Evening, folks.
Right. Take your posts. Quietly.
Another night on patrol.
I've worked worse shifts. Not many.
Eyes up, mouths shut.
kill_streak: Steady hands. That's all it takes.
Not bad for an old man.
wounded: Huh. That's a first this week.
Just a nick. Keep working.
I've been shot at by professionals. This is nothing.
Somebody pass me a bandage.
Well. That's inconvenient.
low_ammo: We're low on rounds. Count 'em.
Make every shot count.
Ammo's down. Time to be choosy.
I've got a magazine and a half. Think about that.
Somebody go see about the bench.
friend_down: Officer down! Somebody get the nurse!
Stay still. Help's on the way.
Hold on. I've seen worse. You'll be fine.
Keep your eyes on me. Good.
breach: Wall's gone! Fall back and hold!
They're through. Tighten up!
Breach! You know what to do.
That's a hole. Plug it.
Contact inside the wire!
dawn: Quiet now. Rest while you can.
Good night's work. Coffee, if there is any.
skill_up: Never too old to learn something.
Still got it. A bit more of it.
Practice. Nothing else works.
Sharper. Good. It'll be needed.
Huh. Learned something. At my age.
breakdown: I need to sit. Just sit.
Thirty years, and this is the one.
Leave me a minute. Just a minute.
Not now. Give me a minute.
epitaph: He walked the wall every night and never once complained.
Walt taught us how to stand a post. We'll keep standing.
A good cop. A better neighbour.

bell: Bell's rung. I'll go to my spot.
It's time. I'm ready.
Evening. Tell me if you need anything.
I'll hold the barricade.
A quiet night, I hope.
kill_streak: I just do what I have to.
Keep them off the wall. That's all.
wounded: It's nothing. Please keep going.
I'm all right. It's only a cut.
Hm. That's bleeding a bit.
Don't worry about me.
Ah. That one hurt.
low_ammo: We don't have much left.
I have the pike. Save the rounds.
Low on bullets. I'll do what I can.
Does anyone have more?
I'll check the bench in the morning.
friend_down: It's okay. It's okay. Stay with me.
I've got you. Don't try to talk.
breach: The wall! It's gone!
They're coming in. Everyone back.
I'll hold it as long as I can.
Oh no. We need to fix this.
Stay behind me.
skill_up: I think I'm getting better. Good.
Learned something. Quietly.
Practice helps. Even now.
A little better. That's all I want.
Hm. Good. I'll keep at it.
breakdown: I can't. I'm sorry. I can't.
Please. I need to be alone.
I'm so tired. So tired.
I just need a moment.
epitaph: Hector kept the school clean and the people kind.
He never asked for anything. We should have asked what he needed.
He tended the garden until the very end.
